title: PipeshubToolStep
description: What a tool step did, on what, and what came of it (WP-112, WP-115), as its row names it: which page it read, what it searched for, which pattern or file, and a search's hits or a find's files. Built by one builder for the loop's steps and every engine's (app/harness/step_display.py); a tool that is none of these actions carries none. Never a tool id, raw arguments or a result's text: those stay behind the step's Details and Show result.

action.description: The action a person reads (toolNames.<action> in the chat's i18n).

target.description: A page's host, a search's query, a find's pattern, a file's path (relative to the workspace).

href.description: The page's link: http or https only, never a citation alias.

title.description: The page's title, once it was read.

count.description: A search's hits, or the files a find or a search listed.

sources.description: The links the result offered, without their text fragments: the answer's citations of them point at this step.
